S1_shear.claim: Fading (c<0 mode, Dovekie full-data fit) predicts cosmic shear better than CPL: Delta chi2_shear(CPL - fading) > 0 at fixed full-data backgrounds with the class_des_fit.py pipeline (nuisances refitted).
S1_shear.scored_by: the next public cosmic-shear 2pt release with covariance (DES Y6 or KiDS-Legacy), analysed with the same pipeline and cuts 10'/60'

S2_phantom_iff_cneg.claim: Within the fading model, w_eff (uncoupled-CDM convention) crosses -1 iff c < 0, near z = 0.8; the c > 0 mode never goes phantom.
S2_phantom_iff_cneg.falsified_if: a fading fit to the new data with c < 0 and no crossing, or c > 0 with a crossing
S2_phantom_iff_cneg.scored_by: DESI DR3 (or later) non-parametric w(z) reconstructions combined with CMB + SN

S3_line_drift.claim: If a dark-matter decay line is detected in clusters, and the decaying particle carries the fading coupling, its rest-frame energy at z ~ 0.5 is offset from local sources by -0.7 to -0.9 percent for c < 0 and +0.75 to +0.94 percent for c > 0.
S3_line_drift.falsified_if: a detected line with offset inconsistent with both signs at the stated amplitude (conditional on the coupling acting on the particle)
S3_line_drift.scored_by: XRISM / Athena line centroids versus redshift

S4_dr3_bao.claim: DESI DR3 BAO alone will not separate fading from CPL by more than Delta chi2 = 4 (Asimov upper bound 3.3-3.9) and will not determine the sign of c (0.2-0.3).
S4_dr3_bao.falsified_if: Delta chi2(CPL vs fading) > 6 from DR3 BAO alone at the frozen fits
S4_dr3_bao.scored_by: DESI DR3 BAO compared with the frozen dr3_prereg.json (sha 6d76b63b)
